name: Pick the best social media posts for a book and group them into chapters with an AI editor
description: Reads exported Facebook and LinkedIn posts with their engagement and comments, picks the stories for the book, groups them into chapters and writes the proposal to a Google Doc for the author to approve.
shortDescription: Turn your best Facebook and LinkedIn posts into a chapter plan for a book.
keyFeatures: AI editor that ranks posts by engagement and by what the comments say
Groups the selected stories into chapters with a running order
Writes the proposal to a Google Doc
prerequisites: Google Sheets and Google Docs connections
A spreadsheet with your exported posts, their engagement numbers and comments; replace REPLACE_WITH_SOCIAL_EXPORT_SPREADSHEET_ID
idealFor: Writers who publish stories on social media and want to turn the best of them into a book.
steps: Read the exported posts from Google Sheets.
The editor agent picks the stories for the book and groups them into chapters.
Write the proposal to a new Google Doc.
